bodyHtml:
On Thursday, April 18 the Spindles held its second annual Media Day.

The Media Day is an opportunity for the club to capture the new kits, headshots, and digital assets for the 2024 season.

These types of events and the passion of the players to be involved is what allows Spindles to grow online.

A special thank you to Rod Dion of TVOI in Downtown Cohoes for allowing us to use his space for the second year straight.

2023 was a success, but 2024 was even bigger with more than 85% of the roster in attendance

Laughs, vamos's, seriousness and posing all made this years media day the success it was.

Follow us on Instagram and Facebook to see the shots from this shoot used regularly!
